brief: A box to hold the joint where I extend a 230 V mains cable to a new wall socket in my garage.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full with top+bottom covers and 6 side caps forms a closed single-cell box; 2x hex-port-gland ports give entry points, 4x hex-port-plug close unused ways. Shape holds a joint and passes cables through.
requirements.requirement: Enclosed box that holds the cable joint and lets cables enter/exit

requirements.evidence: Build is 3D-printed Hex Cluster parts of user-chosen material with no electrical rating, no certified terminals, strain relief, or IP/fire rating verified by the configurator. Mains safety, load, heat, and regulatory compliance cannot be shown by this build.
requirements.requirement: Safe/suitable for 230V mains extension to a new wall socket in garage

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell box with top/bottom covers, capped sides, and 2 cable-gland entries (other ways plugged). Shape suits holding a joint, but 3D-printed parts carry no mains electrical safety rating — use a certified mains junction box with proper terminals and have a qualified electrician do the 230 V garage work to local wiring rules.

parts.name: Rod socket
parts.use: Stands a round tube up off a cell face, so a mast, a stake or a conduit riser is carried by the cluster.

parts.name: Cable comb
parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.

parts.name: Cable comb, two stories tall
parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.

parts.name: Cable comb, three stories tall
parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.

parts.name: Pipe socket
parts.use: Bolts a glue-in socket for 3/4 in pipe to any face that takes a bolt-on: a side flat, or the lid of a bolt cover. Solvent-weld a pipe into it with PVC primer...

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 3/4 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 1/2 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Pipe saddle, 1 in
parts.use: A cradle that carries a run of rigid pipe against a cell, sized by nominal pipe size and closed with a cable tie, so the pipe is held by the cluster instead ...

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.
